title: Figure 6: UAV Range Versus Positron Mass – line graph
description: Line graph showing range in kNM (0 to 350) increasing linearly with positron mass in mg (0.00 to 2.00), reaching about 300 kNM at 2 mg. The caption reads "Figure 6. UAV Range Versus Positron Mass (courtesy Positronics Research LLC)." The text describes a 60-kg UAV with a lift/drag of four that could circumnavigate Earth on 150 μg of positrons.
